runbook.title: ShiftSwap Live Demo
runbook.openingHook: Imagine never having to chase down staff to cover a shift again.
runbook.problemStatement: Managers spend significant time managing shift swaps and still face uncovered shifts.

demoPlan.script: Welcome everyone. Today, I'm excited to introduce you to ShiftSwap, the app designed to simplify shift management for restaurant owners and managers. Our goal is to ensure every shift is covered without the hassle of chasing down staff.

demoPlan.step: Show how easy it is for staff to request a shift swap through the app.
demoPlan.script: Let’s dive into the app. Here, you can see how easy it is for staff to request a shift swap. They simply select their shift and propose a swap with another team member. It’s user-friendly and designed to minimize the time spent on this process.

demoPlan.step: Demonstrate the one-tap approval process for managers.
demoPlan.script: Now, let’s look at the manager's side. With just one tap, managers can approve or deny the swap requests. This streamlined process saves time and ensures that you maintain control over your schedule.

demoPlan.step: Highlight the overtime and certification checks in action.
demoPlan.script: Next, I want to highlight the built-in checks for overtime and certifications. When a staff member requests a swap, the app automatically checks compliance, ensuring you never have to worry about overtime violations or unqualified staff covering shifts.

demoPlan.step: Present a use case: filling a shift after a last-minute cancellation.
demoPlan.script: Let’s consider a real-world scenario. Imagine a last-minute cancellation. With ShiftSwap, your staff can quickly find someone to cover the shift, ensuring that your restaurant operates smoothly without any gaps.

demoPlan.step: Summarize the benefits and invite questions.
demoPlan.script: In summary, ShiftSwap not only saves you time but also ensures that every shift is covered efficiently. Now, I’d love to hear your questions.

questions: How will my staff adapt to using the app?
What support do you provide during onboarding?
Can you share success stories from other restaurants?
runbook.ctaScript: Sign up for a free trial today! Experience how ShiftSwap can streamline your shift management and ensure every shift is covered.
runbook.closingScript: Thank you for joining me today. I look forward to seeing you sign up for your free trial and transforming your shift management process.
